## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-4 biopsy with a single-class conformal set, though high neoplastic cell counts warrant checking region 5.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 97%, InSitu 3%, Normal 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strong benign probability; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% target |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 86th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; error AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 2/5 InSitu, 1/5 Normal [F5] | Split neighbors; two InSitu matches |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.46; contribution -0.92) pushes strongly against invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 10) · context · Above-typical score (+1.18; contribution -0.59); descriptive only (8/20 spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 7, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (+1.33; contribution -0.46) favors benign architecture [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Score +0.88 (contribution -0.19), but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell fraction / density** (regions 1, 5, 6) · context · 84% neoplastic nuclei (99th percentile) [F7]; 2472/mm² density (96th percentile) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Dense neoplastic nuclei (84%, 99th percentile) in regions 1, 5, 6 represent in situ carcinoma rather than benign proliferation.
- Duct-confined atypia in region 10 (+0.77) reflects InSitu, matching contrast case `BACH_0351` (87% similarity) and 2/5 neighbors.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 6, 1**: Verify why region 5 has 36% risk and 84% measured neoplastic nuclei across these regions.
2. **Region 10**: Check ducts for in situ atypia, the key separator from InSitu contrast case `BACH_0351`.
3. **Regions 7, 8, 9**: Confirm benign tubule architecture and absence of stromal invasion driving the benign prediction.
